results.text: Hydralazine inhibits cysteamine dioxygenase to treat preeclampsia and senesce glioblastoma. Hydralazine (HYZ), a treatment for preeclampsia and hypertensive crisis, is listed by the World Health Organization as an essential medicine. Its mode of action has remained unknown through its seven decades of clinical use.
